result.title: Diving Deeper into Dense Keypoint Localization in Object Pose Estimation
result.summary: 6D pose estimation of rigid objects is a fundamental and challenging task in computer vision. Recent dense semantic keypoint-based methods employ binary encoding for efficient global keypoint localization, delivering strong performance in object pose estimation. Nevertheless, the discontinuous nature of binary encoding hinders effective training at high resolutions, while its inherent discrete and quantization errors lead to significant localization uncertainty. We propose GHLAPose, a global-to-local framework that synergizes hybrid Gray-binary (HGB) encoding with local-aware refinement (LAR). Specifically, HGB encoding first alleviates discontinuity to achieve accurate initial global keypoint localization. To further address intrinsic encoding errors, the LAR module estimates uncertainty and refines keypoint localization. This synergy enables a precise global-to-local strategy by aggregating global and local features. Extensive experiments on LM, LM-O, YCB-V, and TUD-L datasets demonstrate that GHLAPose surpasses state-of-the-art methods, particularly on fine-grained metrics. On LM-O, it outperforms the second-best method by 1.4% and 1.9% on ADD(-S) 0.02d and 0.05d respectively, and on YCB-V by 1% on ADD(-S) 0.1d. The code will be available at GHLAPose.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 GHLAPose，用混合 Gray-binary 编码缓解二值编码的不连续性与量化误差以完成全局关键点定位，再由局部感知精化模块估计不确定性并修正定位，构成由粗到细的 6D 物体位姿估计框架。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「离散编码量化误差 + 不确定性驱动局部精化」可供核查是否能类比 LVR 中紧凑 latent 表示的信息坍缩与后续证据补充，但任务本身为位姿估计，与多模态推理距离较远。
